exactSubmittedPrompt:
Design ONE polished product-art direction board for 在场, a literary companion workspace that lives inside a warm wooden room. The task is QUIET, LOCAL FAILURE AND RECOVERY, not an error dashboard. The supplied two images are CLEAN EMPTY room plates: dry-night and clear-day. Use their wood, curtains, lamps, window and air as the environmental/art reference ONLY. Draw fresh authentic interface components. No character, avatar or cat is needed. Never introduce a large pale/dark alert rectangle, global banner, modal, screen dimmer, red warning badge, technical English, stack trace or admin console.

Emotional intent: a small action did not finish, yet the room and one's work stay steady. The recovery belongs to the hand that just acted. A restrained mark at the original file corner or composer is enough; readable warm text is clear, not hidden, but attention is not hijacked. Night surfaces feel like smoked tea and amber light on wood, with soft warm ivory ink. Day uses a little warm paper only where a real editable sheet exists. No green UI.

WIDE 2:1 art-direction board, ideally 2048x1024. It has FOUR deliberately unequal views of FOUR DIFFERENT MOMENTS, with one dominant whole-app night welcome view taking about 60% of the board on the left, and three small contextual detail views arranged down the right. These are separate design views, not simultaneous product windows and not a day/night slider. Keep simple fine spacing between views; no decorative frames, captions explaining architecture, or error-state control panel.

CRITICAL EXACT COMPONENT LIMITS: In every composer draw ONLY draft text, a small plus/attachment entry, and ONE relevant send-origin control. No book button, A/font button, divider tools, desktop sidebar or invented nav. Top app navigation is just the subtle words 聊天 今天 留下 in one row; no left sidebar, no new labels 灵感 or 设置. The greeting 回来啦。 stands ALONE with NO subtitle. Do not write 继续你未完成的思考吧 or any extra helper sentence. The status glyph is a 3px open amber notch, NOT a bright filled orange dot.

SEND-UNKNOWN SAFETY IS VISIBLE: In the second acknowledgement-unknown composer, REMOVE THE SEND ARROW / AIRPLANE ENTIRELY. At the normal send-origin there is only the quiet 查看结果 action next to 这条还没确认; that is the sole next action. In waiting composer, REMOVE THE SEND ARROW and use only a small square stop/cancel control 取消. No separate active send control in either state. This must be visible in the image, not merely explained.

DOMINANT LEFT VIEW: beautiful open whole-room NIGHT welcome. Small brand 在场 and restrained nav at the top. A warm greeting such as 回来啦。 above one compact, light smoked-tea composer in the left portion. The right room window seat, curtains and night landscape remain open. The file-attachment add action at composer lower-left just failed to open. DIRECTLY BESIDE THAT ORIGINAL PLUS/SMALL RED BOOKLET LOCATION, show only a tiny open amber notch/dot and the compact inline words 刚才没打开 followed by a quiet underlined action 重试. At ordinary UI scale this line is only about 160–210px wide, a small footnote in the same visual field, with no block background. It does not span the input width or sit across the greeting. No cross-screen toast. The original draft stays editable; no fake attachment or user file content.

UPPER RIGHT DETAIL VIEW, DAYLIGHT SOURCE CORNER: a readable piece of actual-source paper with a short file tab 讲义 and a small red bespoke booklet at its corner. Its old saved mark is no longer valid because the source changed. Old wrong highlight is absent. At that SAME original mark corner, a tiny warm paper-turn edge carrying only 资料有变化 and the small action 回原处. The paper's useful content is not covered, no red alarm. The few body lines are illustrative layout marks, not a fake real PDF, exact formula, author or claim of having read a user file.

MIDDLE RIGHT DETAIL VIEW, NIGHT COMPOSER TWO CONSECUTIVE BEATS of the SAME draft: show two compact composer crops one above the other, close enough to recognize continuity, not two simultaneously present duplicate inputs. The draft reads 我想对照这两段。 in both.
First beat is a truthful connection wait: a very small incomplete amber ring at the send-origin, short 还在连接 and a small 取消 action in place. No percent, no tutorial, no flashing.
Second beat is a send acknowledgement UNKNOWN state: draft remains intact and the send-origin has the tiny words 这条还没确认 with 查看结果 as its quiet action. No second resend button, no checkmark of success and no failed-send red bubble. View results before another send is possible; the two beats do not both appear in a live composer. No arrows.

LOWER RIGHT DETAIL VIEW, DAYLIGHT SAVING: a small existing note open on warm paper, short title 两段之间, a few calm lines of the still-visible editable original draft, with one caret left where the person was writing. Only at the save-origin/paper corner show small 未保存 · 原稿还在 and a quiet 重试. This phrase is specifically conditional on the original draft truly being visible and retained in this view. No tick claiming save completed, no recreated note, no giant toast.

Craft: precise optical alignment, well-spaced crisp Chinese text, fine amber/ochre accent, warm off-white/night ink readable at small scale, softly lit wood/linen behind. The controls are quiet yet legible and keyboard-focus can later be visible on the action, but do not draw tutorial labels. Night main view has NO huge cream card or separate charcoal failure slab. A real PDF page can be light only in its own daylight source detail, not the whole app. At most one relevant status in each current moment, no pile of five unrelated alerts in the room. No fake developer wording including setAttachment, undefined, loading, error codes, debug, queue, validation or interface. No universal comforting slogan. The relation among original object, unfinished action, truthful retained work and next available action should be visible without explanatory paragraphs.

producerObservation: Personally viewed returned full board. Main status sits beside attachment plus without separate wide alert slab; source-change note stays at original paper corner; composer waiting and acknowledgement-unknown are successive preserved-draft states; unknown-send no longer shows second send arrow. Save failure sits at note corner with actual illustrated draft retained. Day/night are separate design states not runtime split screen.
adoptionBoundary: Open amber rings on failed open/source/save are static notches only: do not spin them like waiting. Only actual connection waiting may animate, with reduced-motion static alternative.

Normal welcome send control omitted by generator is not a feature removal: preserve real existing send affordance and draft focus. Composer geometry and placeholder are illustration only; use current lightweight real composer.
Rendered note/PDF text and room pixels are illustrative, not actual user content, exact PDF or new runtime background.
Only one current local recovery state per affected operation; do not show the whole board in app or create new error dashboard.
Read-only failure may offer true retry; uncertain send must inspect original attempt before any retry, never duplicate.
Keyboard focus, cancel, source validity and retained draft truth need actual owner interaction evidence; image is not functional acceptance.
